title: Pointed! Bloomberg's Weekly News Quiz For Risk-Takers
title_cn: 尖！彭博社针对冒险者的每周新闻测验
summary: Pointed offers a strategic twist to the news quiz format, testing not just players’ knowledge of the news but also their confidence in their answers. Join Bloomberg's Joe Mathieu, Carol Massar and Lisa Mateo as they play and check out the quiz for yourself at Bloomberg.com (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Colombia Quake Tests New President Days Into Term
title_cn: 哥伦比亚地震考验新总统上任数天
summary: Rescuers in western Colombia are still searching for survivors after a 7.4 magnitude earthquake killed at least 287 people. Bloomberg News Latin America Government Reporter Mie Dahl joins Bloomberg This Weekend from Bogotá and explains to hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar that the disaster has also disrupted coffee exports and created an immediate leadership test for President Abelardo de la Espriella, who was sworn in just days before the quake struck. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Drone Swarms Push AI Deeper Into Modern Warfare
title_cn: 无人机群将人工智能推向现代战争
summary: Bloomberg News Cyber Security & Tech Reporter Katrina Manson got a firsthand look at autonomous drone-swarm technology that allows multiple aircrafts to coordinate and strike targets even when communications or GPS are disrupted. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend, Mason explains to Carol Massar that the Pentagon is testing the technology as part of its Swarm Forge program, but experiments in which AI identified civilian vehicles as potential targets highlight the risks as militaries push toward greater autonomy in warfare. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lakers Deal Caps Billionaire Rush Into Sports
title_cn: 湖人队交易让亿万富翁纷纷涌入体育界
summary: Bob Iger and Josh Kushner moved from pursuing a Las Vegas NBA expansion team to agreeing within days to buy the Los Angeles Lakers in a record $12.5 billion deal. Bloomberg News Host of Sports City Randall Williams is on Bloomberg This Weekend with hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar and explains that the transaction comes as Madison Square Garden Sports moves toward separating the Knicks and Rangers businesses and Jeff Bezos joins a group taking a minority stake in Liverpool, underscoring investor demand for scarce live-sports assets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Strong Earnings Keep PNC’s Agati Bullish on Stocks
title_cn: 强劲的盈利让 PNC 的阿加蒂看好股票
summary: PNC's Chief Investment Officer Amanda Agati is on Bloomberg This Weekend with hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar and says that strong earnings and economic fundamentals continue to support US stocks, even as elevated Treasury yields and midterm uncertainty threaten to bring more volatility. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US-Iran War Risks Repeated Cycles of Fighting
title_cn: 美伊战争有反复循环的风险
summary: Shifting US objectives and neither side able to secure a decisive military victory make a lasting resolution difficult and Bloomberg Economics Defense Lead Becca Wasser says risks the the US-Iran conflict becoming a protracted war. Joining Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend, Wasser explains that repeated pauses could allow both sides to adapt and rearm, potentially expanding the conflict geographically and making direct US-Iran talks necessary for a durable settlement. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: By The Way: Headline You May Have Missed
title_cn: 顺便说一句：你可能错过了标题
summary: Mystery vacations, college campuses for sale, buying sorority unwritten rules, and half off sushi: Bloomberg News' Lisa Mateo joins Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend to share headlines you may have missed from over the week. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump's ‘Golden Age’ Pitch Meets Affordability Frustration
title_cn: 特朗普的“黄金时代”宣传遭遇了负担能力的挫败
summary: President Donald Trump is touting a “golden age” for the US economy, but Bloomberg News White House Correspondent Catherine Lucey is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says persistent concerns over gas, food and housing costs are complicating that message ahead of the midterms. Lucey explains to hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar that Republicans in competitive races face a difficult balance between embracing Trump’s economic record and addressing voters who remain frustrated about affordability and the economic fallout from the Iran war. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: ‘Outlier’ S&P 500 Earnings Strength Cheers Wall Street’s Bulls
title_cn: 标准普尔 500 指数“异常”盈利实力为华尔街多头欢呼
summary: Corporate America is blowing past Wall Street’s expectations for a stellar earnings season, adding to the rosy backdrop for a stock market trading near a record high.

title: Robinson Says Activists Need Leverage to Win
title_cn: 罗宾逊表示活动人士需要利用杠杆才能获胜
summary: Author of the book 'From Presence to Power' Rashad Robinson is on Bloomberg This Weekend and explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that visibility, media attention and public support do not amount to power unless activists build the leverage needed to change decisions and institutions. Robinson draws on campaigns involving LGBTQ rights, racial justice and technology companies to make the case for moving beyond awareness toward strategies that produce lasting change. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: USS Abraham Lincoln Conditions Raise Readiness Concerns
title_cn: 亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰状况引发战备担忧
summary: Navy veteran and military journalist Natalie Oliverio joins Bloomberg This Weekend and says reported food, sanitation and communication problems aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln risk undermining sailors’ readiness. Oliverio explains to hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar that families and lawmakers are demanding answers as the carrier has spent more than 240 consecutive days at sea, while the Pentagon disputes reports portraying conditions aboard the ship as dire. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Modi Puts Chips, Nuclear Power at Heart of India Push
title_cn: 莫迪将芯片和核电作为印度发展的核心
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi used his Independence Day address to lay out an ambitious path toward making India a developed economy by 2047, emphasizing self-reliance, semiconductor manufacturing, AI and nuclear power. Joining hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the Prime Ministers speech is Bloomberg News Senior Reporter Dan Strumpf. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Inflation Is Cooling. But is 2% Out of Reach?
title_cn: 通货膨胀正在降温。但2%遥不可及吗？
summary: BlackRock’s Rick Rieder says the latest CPI report gave markets reason to celebrate, but inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% target. He argues the economy is now “in the ballpark” and that raising overnight rates may not be the most effective way to bring inflation lower. The bigger issue for markets may be the long end of the yield curve, where fiscal deficits, heavy treasury issuance and AI-related financing  push real rates higher. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: In the Inflation Ballpark
title_cn: 在通货膨胀范围内
summary: We’re not at target yet.

summary: The Trump administration is considering additional sanctions on Iran as the Strait of Hormuz blockade squeezes oil flows and keeps pressure on US gasoline prices. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend is Axios Business Reporter Nathan Bomey who says Washington could target companies or countries doing business with Iran, potentially putting China and its purchases of Iranian oil in the spotlight. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Joining Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the war in Ukraine one year after the Trump-Putin Alaska summit, Former Republican Congressman and current CEO of RIIG Technologies Denver Riggleman also spoke with hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar about the role of private companies in offensive US cyber operations. Riggleman says that these operations could create serious risks if targets are misidentified or attacks produce unintended consequences. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Amazon.com Inc. reintroduced a clause in its user agreement that seeks to prevent shoppers from filing class-action lawsuits against the online retailer, inserting a legal buffer between itself and plaintiffs attorneys that it removed five years ago.

title: Signs of a Slowing US Consumer | Open Interest 8/14/2026
title_cn: 美国消费放缓的迹象|未平仓合约 8/14/2026
summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dave Gura on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Signs the consumer is finally slowing sown. Today, retail sales post their biggest drop in more than a year as confidence slides. Oil rises as Washington threatens more economic pressure on Iran. Plus, OpenAI’s revenue surge ahead of a highly anticipated IPO. And we’ll hear from Flock Safety CEO Garrett Langley and LOVB Pro Commissioner Sandra Idehen on the $20 million boom in women’s volleyball. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: OpenAI’s Explosive Growth Continues | Bloomberg Tech 8/14/2026
title_cn: OpenAI 持续爆炸式增长 |彭博科技 2026 年 8 月 14 日
summary: Bloomberg’s Tim Stenovec takes a look at OpenAI, which is on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $40 billion, roughly doubling its run rate from the end of 2025. Plus, how a New York City bill backed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani could force Amazon to directly employ its delivery workers, and Meta's former chief AI scientist joins a new venture firm to invest in early AI startups. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Beyond Chatbots: The Next Wave of AI
title_cn: 超越聊天机器人：人工智能的下一波浪潮
summary: 224 Ventures is a new AI-native venture firm launched by former AIX Ventures co-founder Shaun Johnson, ex-Google DeepMind researcher Oriol Vinyals, and AI pioneer Yann LeCun. The trio plans to make seed-stage bets and launches with more than $100 million in assets under management. 224 Ventures General Partner Shaun Johnson discusses why the most compelling opportunities may be “nonconsensus” bets, with white space emerging in the future of work, robotics and infrastructure. He joins Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: OpenAI on Track to Double Revenue Ahead of IPO
title_cn: OpenAI 有望在 IPO 前实现收入翻倍
summary: OpenAI is on track to generate more than $40 billion in annualized revenue, roughly double its run rate at the end of 2025, according to sources. Bloomberg’s Rachel Metz explains how growth in paying ChatGPT users, enterprise adoption and coding assistant Codex are driving the surge, and why the enormous cost of computing power remains a key challenge for the AI company. She joins Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Zambian President Hichilema Takes Early Lead in Reelection Bid
title_cn: 赞比亚总统希奇莱马在连任竞选中取得领先
summary: Zambia’s president took an early lead in elections in which he’s seeking to extend his rule of the copper-rich southern African nation.

title: What Bessent’s Economic Isolation Of Iran Could Look Like
title_cn: 贝森特对伊朗的经济孤立会是什么样子
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the US is getting ready to squeeze Iran with unprecedented economic pressure, a claim critics greeted with skepticism given the country is already subject to a naval blockade and thousands of sanctions.

title: Iran, Oman Home In on Hormuz Strait Deal as Ship Attacks Mount
title_cn: 随着船舶袭击事件增多，伊朗和阿曼就霍尔木兹海峡达成协议
summary: Iran and Oman appear to be edging closer to a deal on how the Strait of Hormuz should be managed, agreeing on routes through the key waterway that’s proved a major stumbling block in efforts to end almost six months of war between the Islamic Republic and the US.

title: Hormuz Ship Attacks Mount as US Vows to Cripple Iran Economy
title_cn: 美国誓言削弱伊朗经济，霍尔木兹船只袭击事件愈演愈烈
summary: More ships have come under attack in the Strait of Hormuz as talks to end the war in the Middle East remain stalled and the US readies new economic measures to force Iran to capitulate.

title: Zelenskyy Says Ukraine Strikes Russian Space Facility in Samara
title_cn: 泽连斯基称乌克兰袭击了俄罗斯萨马拉航天设施
summary: Ukraine said it attacked a production unit of the Roscosmos space agency as it continued strikes at military and related infrastructure deep within Russia.

title_cn: 日本防卫大臣在中国紧张局势期间参拜靖国神社
summary: Japan’s defense minister visited a shrine seen by Japan’s neighbors as a symbol of its wartime militarism, drawing condemnation from China following months of tension between the countries.

title_cn: 英国在中国恐慌后加强对国防供应链的审查
summary: The UK Ministry of Defense is stepping-up scrutiny of its supply chain after discovering some of its naval drones transmitted signals to China.

title: Burnham’s Strategy Against a Fractured Right Is Coming Into View
title_cn: 伯纳姆针对破碎权利的策略正在浮出水面
summary: Addressing a private meeting of Labour’s ministerial advisers this week, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he’d moved on from believing in the “if you’re explaining, you’re losing” maxim popularized by Ronald Reagan.

title: Trump on Higher Gas Prices: 'I'll Never Apologize' | Balance of Power: Late Edition 08/14/2026
title_cn: 特朗普谈汽油价格上涨：“我永远不会道歉”权力平衡：最新版 08/14/2026
summary: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Democratic Representative Gwen Moore of Wisconsin says higher gasoline prices are deepening Americans' cost-of-living squeeze, pushing back on President Donald Trump's comments that Americans should accept paying "a tiny bit more" at the pump because of the war with Iran. Republican Representative Mike Flood of Nebraska says affordability is a concern he continues to hear from constituents, despite President Donald Trump dismissing the issue as a "hoax." Democratic Representative Greg Casar of Texas says AI CEOs should testify before Congress about employment and national security concerns surrounding the technology. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Military Option for Cuba Fades as Trump Focuses on Sanctions
title_cn: 随着特朗普专注于制裁，美国对古巴的军事选择逐渐消失
summary: The Trump administration’s Cuba strategy is increasingly focused on ramping up sanctions and economic pressure rather than deploying military force to break the island’s Communist leadership, people familiar with the matter said.

title: Rep. Casar on Texas Data Center Freeze
title_cn: 众议员卡萨尔谈德克萨斯州数据中心冻结
summary: Democratic Representative Greg Casar of Texas says AI CEOs should testify before Congress about employment and national security concerns surrounding the technology. Rep. Casar argues data center projects should be blocked if they raise electricity bills or otherwise harm the communities where they’re built. He discusses legislation that would impose a tax on large AI companies and increase the rate as unemployment rises, with revenue used to support a federal jobs program. Rep. Casar also says Democrats should focus on working people and argues Republican efforts to label Democrats communists are a familiar political tactic that won’t work. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rep. Flood: Affordability at Center of Reelection Campaign
title_cn: 众议员洪水：负担能力是连任竞选的中心
summary: Republican Representative Mike Flood of Nebraska says affordability is a concern he continues to hear from constituents, despite President Donald Trump dismissing the issue as a "hoax." Flood, who chairs the Republican Main Street Caucus, says recently passed housing legislation will help boost supply and lower home prices, though he acknowledges relief may not arrive quickly. Flood also says the US needs to "finish the job" in Iran while putting the mental health, safety and morale of American service members at the highest level of concern. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Higher Gas Costs Are ‘Busting’ Budgets: Moore
title_cn: 摩尔：更高的天然气成本正在“破坏”预算
summary: Democratic Representative Gwen Moore of Wisconsin says higher gasoline prices are deepening Americans' cost-of-living squeeze, pushing back on President Donald Trump's comments that Americans should accept paying "a tiny bit more" at the pump because of the war with Iran. Rep. Moore says even modest increases are creating "chaos and hardship" for families. She also says Francesca Hong's strong showing in Wisconsin's Democratic gubernatorial primary demonstrated the resonance of her affordability message, while arguing Democrats shouldn't be bullied by Republican efforts to characterize safety-net policies as communism. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title_cn: 伯纳姆通过抗旱支持表达了对英国农民的担忧
summary: The UK government announced new support for farmers, including flexibility in environmental subsidy schemes and support for building reservoirs, as the country grapples with widespread drought and falling crop yields.

title: Trump to Attend Meeting with Crypto, Prediction Markets Execs
title_cn: 特朗普将出席与加密货币、预测市场高管的会议
summary: President Donald Trump is expected to attend a meeting at the White House next Wednesday that will gather together high-level executives from crypto companies and prediction-market venues, according to a person familiar with the event.
